purpose: Choose the nearest clearance-feasible initial connector-run start, rather than choose an unsafe start and repair it afterward.

algorithm.method: For each run in N/E/S/W order, subtract open collision intervals from its closed margin domain and choose the legal point nearest the affinity-weighted preferred start; lower coordinate breaks ties. Recheck actual rounded geometry independently.
constraints: actual rounded same-edge and cross-edge clearance
limitations: Sequential run decisions are not a complete joint solver.
A rounded unsafe boundary is rejected; no additional quantized-boundary search yet.
Keepout checks use strict non-overlap (zero tolerance), conservatively stronger than the outer check.
This option is not yet exposed through the full board CLI.
algorithm.accounting: All executed quantization calls remain counted, including rejected geometry; initial runs, generated collision intervals and rejected runs are observed separately. The existing edge-translation repair implementation and fallback accounting are unchanged.

coverage: 44550 dyadic interval-oracle comparisons including reversed obstacle order
8208 collision-interval comparisons against the physical clearance predicate
isolated feasible points and open boundaries
independently instrumented quantization counts for accepted and rejected initial poses
default carrier and devkit packing regression coverage
